messages:
micah: quick Q — i'm about to merge a terraform change that wires up a SecretStore + role binding for ExternalSecrets -> Vault. anyone see obvious issues with the serviceAccount bindings or rotation config? PR: https://git.redwoodinference.dev/infra/infra-secrets/pulls/3456

ashley: pinging infra folks. are you using KV v2? ext-secrets needs the provider configured for kvv2=true OR the path should omit /data/. common pitfall. also watch bound_service_account_namespaces in the Vault role.

micah: yep KV v2. TF has `kv_v2 = true` in the provider block and path set to `teams/redwood/api`. snippet in the PR: `path = "teams/redwood/api"` — i lifted the example from our vault module.

sara: a couple quick checks: 1) add an annotation so canaries refresh faster (e.g., `external-secrets.io/refresh-interval: 30s`) 2) ensure target secret name includes env suffix so we don't clobber existing prod secret during rollout.

micah: good point. i'll create a canary ExternalSecret named `api-key-canary` in staging first. also planning to schedule merge+apply in the 2am PST maintenance window on 2025-05-23.

tom: verifying Vault auth bits — the role should have these fields: `bound_service_account_names: ["external-secrets-sa"]` and `bound_service_account_namespaces: ["infra"]` (or whatever ns you put the SA in). also policy should only allow read on `secret/data/teams/redwood/api`.

micah: here's the SecretStore + ExternalSecret yaml i'm planning to apply (trimmed):
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: SecretStore
metadata:
  name: vault-secretstore
spec:
  provider:
    vault:
      server: { url: "https://vault.internal:8200" }
      path: ""
      version: "v2"
      auth:
        kubernetes:
          role: "ext-secrets-role"
---
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: api-key-canary
  namespace: staging
  annotations:
    external-secrets.io/refresh-interval: "30s"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "30s"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-secretstore
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: api-key-canary
  data:
  - secretKey: api_key
    remoteRef:
      key: teams/redwood/api
      property: api_key
```

ashley: looks fine. minor nit: remove `path: ""` in the SecretStore provider if it's unused. and confirm TLS cert for vault.internal is trusted by cluster.

micah: noted — i'll remove the empty path and add cert check. also added a small terraform plan in the PR: `Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy` (it will create the k8s SecretStore CR and the Vault role binding resources).

devops-bot: CI passed for PR #3456 :white_check_mark:

sara: lgtm from me. once canary is healthy, do the prod rollout with `refreshInterval: 5m`. keep the canary for 24h and then flip.

ashley: reviewing now, minor suggestion: for rotation safety, create a fallback secret (api-key-old) and have a short docs blurb in the PR describing rollback steps (kubectl patch secret or delete ExternalSecret to revert).

micah: added fallback secret plan and rollback steps to the PR description. updated ExternalSecret template to use `target.name: api-key-canary` so it's isolated. merging in ~15m unless objections.

ashley: no objections. please post in #incidents if anything odd during rollout.

micah: merged at 1765125500, applied staging canary. terraform output: "Apply complete! Resources: 1 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed." canary pod picked up secret successfully. scheduling prod apply 2025-05-23 02:00 PST.

devops-bot: deployment pipeline for infra-secrets/3456 completed :rocket:

micah: will keep thread updated during prod rollout. thanks all :pray:
